title: Whole-body movements during rising to standing from sitting
assessment: Checked primary source content only. No motion, rig, clinical or dataset acceptance.
checkedScope: Inspected primary PubMed indexed abstract and bibliography, PMID2217543. Direct open returned incomplete content. Verified four chair-rise phase descriptions; no numerical spinal targets or raw kinematics verified.

claims.description: Abstract describes four chair-rise phases: momentum generation, seat-off transfer, extension and stabilization.

limitations: Exact chair height, speed, kinetics and numerical lumbar/hip values not reconciled.
Abstract does not directly establish sheet’s12-degree lumbar target or a universal hip-to-spine ratio.
No current body-variant matching or trajectory import.
